subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a public per-model non-resetting generation deadline distinct from provider request/idle timeout and the whole agent-run timeout?
rationale: Current source proves the capability is missing, but a new core config/default surface and its precedence, fallback, and upgrade semantics require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Add Generation Deadline
options.body: Introduce one typed global default plus per-model override, resolved and enforced per fallback candidate with explicit precedence and timeout classification.

options.title: Keep Existing Controls
options.body: Retain provider request/idle and whole-run timeouts, accepting that individual models sharing a provider cannot have separate total budgets.

options.title: Fix Narrow Bugs First
options.body: Land concrete thinking-stream and repetition fixes first, then revisit configuration if operators still need model-specific total budgets.

recommendation.title: Add Generation Deadline
recommendation.body: Introduce one typed global default plus per-model override, resolved and enforced per fallback candidate with explicit precedence and timeout classification.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the most detailed product-shape review and have recent history across the affected runner, model, and config surfaces.
